info.title: CAO 48.1 Compliance API
info.description:
A stateless REST API for validating flight crew duty periods against the Australian Civil Aviation Order 48.1 Instrument 2019 (Compilation No. 3, F2021C01239).

Covers Appendices 1 through 6 with validation (pass/fail with clause references), calculation (max FDP, min off-duty), and direct access to the legislative text.

**Disclaimer:** This API is derived from CAO 48.1 and is provided for reference purposes only. It does not replace your operator's approved Fatigue Management Manual (FMM), a qualified fatigue risk management assessment, or professional regulatory advice.

get.summary: FDP lookup table for an appendix
get.description: Returns the Flight Duty Period lookup table for a given appendix, including time bands, sector-based limits, split duty caps, and flight time limits. Appendix 2 returns the primary acclimatised table; use the /calculate/max-fdp endpoint for augmented crew or unknown acclimatisation sub-tables.

example.message: Appendix '99' is not a valid appendix identifier.

get.summary: Cumulative limit thresholds for an appendix
get.description: Returns the cumulative flight time, duty time, and recovery period thresholds for a given appendix. These are the rolling-window limits that operators must track.

example.message: Appendix '99' is not a valid appendix identifier.

post.description: Given operational parameters (appendix, start time, sectors, crew configuration, split duty), calculates the maximum permissible Flight Duty Period with a clause-referenced breakdown of all adjustments.
Given the preceding FDP details and operational context, calculates the minimum required off-duty period with clause references and reduction eligibility assessment.

Validates a single Flight Duty Period against all applicable rules for the specified appendix. Returns every check run (passed and failed) plus a top-level `valid` flag. Each violation includes a CAO 48.1 clause reference and a remediation suggestion.

Optionally validates extension type and hours if an extension is supplied, and checks the per-FDP flight time limit when `actual_flight_time_hours` is provided.

200.description: Validation completed successfully. Inspect the `valid` field for the pass/fail outcome.

post.description: Validates an off-duty period between two FDPs against the minimum required ODP for the specified appendix. Optionally verifies that reduction eligibility conditions are satisfied if `reduction_claimed` is True. Returns all checks run with clause references and, where relevant, remediation guidance.

200.description: Validation completed successfully. Inspect the `valid` field for the pass/fail outcome.

post.summary: Validate cumulative flight time and recovery limits
post.description:
Validates rolling-window cumulative limits (flight time, duty time, recovery blocks, minimum days off) for the specified appendix.

Accepts either a full FDP history log (preferred — the API computes all windows) or pre-aggregated summary totals (accepted when a full log is unavailable).

For Appendices 5 and 5A, a 5+ consecutive-day gap in the FDP log is automatically detected and used to reset the flight time accumulation counter.

200.description: Validation completed. Inspect `valid` for pass/fail outcome.

post.summary: Validate an ordered sequence of FDPs and off-duty periods
post.description:
Validates a chronologically ordered sequence of FDP and off-duty events as a complete roster window.

Checks performed:
- Each individual FDP (duration, flight time limits)
- Each off-duty period between FDPs (minimum ODP requirements)
- Consecutive WOCL infringement rule (§13.2): after 3 consecutive WOCL infringements, the next WOCL-infringing FDP must be preceded by an off-duty period that includes a local night
- Rolling cumulative limits (flight time, duty time, recovery) evaluated over the full sequence

Each check result is prefixed with its event context (e.g. `fdp1_fdp_within_limit`, `odp1_minimum_odp`, `cumulative_flight_time_28d`).

200.description: Validation completed. Inspect `valid` for pass/fail outcome.

post.description:
Validates a complete ordered roster of FDP, off-duty, and rest-day events against all applicable CAO 48.1 rules for the specified appendix.

Checks performed:
- Each individual FDP (duration, flight time, extension validity)
- Each off-duty period between FDPs (minimum ODP requirements)
- Sequence-level checks: consecutive WOCL infringement rule (§13.2) and consecutive early-start reductions
- Rolling cumulative limits (flight time, duty time, recovery blocks, days off) evaluated across roster FDPs combined with any supplied prior history

Returns a structured per-event breakdown (fdp_results, odp_results), sequence-level checks, cumulative result, and a flat all_violations list for quick scanning.

200.description: Validation completed. Inspect `valid` for pass/fail outcome.

get.description:
Returns a structured JSON document covering every endpoint: purpose, when to use it versus alternatives, the non-obvious parameter semantics, a worked example, and common integration mistakes.

Call this endpoint **once at the start of a session** to orient an LLM or integration before making compliance calls. The response is stable between requests and may be cached for the duration of a session.

get.description: Returns the full table of contents for CAO 48.1 Instrument 2019, listing all Parts and Appendices with their constituent sections. Each section includes an ID that can be used with the `GET /sections/{section_id}` endpoint to retrieve the full text.

get.summary: Get a specific section or appendix of CAO 48.1
get.description:
Returns the full text of a specific section or group from CAO 48.1 Instrument 2019.

**Supported lookup patterns:**

- `PART 1`, `PART 2`, `PART 3` — returns the Part with a list of its sections
- `APPENDIX 1`, `APPENDIX 2`, ..., `APPENDIX 7` — returns the Appendix with a list of its sections
- `6`, `7`, `14` — returns an individual section from the Parts (e.g. section 6 is Definitions)
- `APPENDIX 3.2`, `APPENDIX 1.4` — returns a specific section within an Appendix

Use `GET /sections` to discover available section IDs.

200.description: Section or group found and returned.

CumulativeSummaryInput.title: CumulativeSummaryInput
CumulativeSummaryInput.description:
Pre-aggregated cumulative totals — accepted as a fallback when
a full FDP history log is not available.

Provide whichever totals are relevant to your appendix.
Window definitions:
  168h = rolling 7-day window
  336h = rolling 14-day window
  28d  = rolling 28-day window
  90d  = rolling 90-day window
  365d = rolling 365-day window
  384h = rolling 16-day window (Appendix 4A, 5A)

Lists all Parts and Appendices with their constituent sections.
Each section includes an ID that can be used with the
GET /sections/{section_id} endpoint.

time_band.title: Time Band
time_band.description: Time band label, e.g. '0700-1259' or '<30h off-duty'.

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: Maximum FDP hours keyed by sector grouping. Keys vary by appendix: '1-3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8+' for multi-pilot; 'single_pilot', 'multi_1_2', 'multi_3+' for aerial work; 'all' for single-value tables.

TimeBandRow.title: TimeBandRow
TimeBandRow.description: One row of the FDP table: a time band with limits per sector grouping.

as_of_utc.title: As Of Utc
as_of_utc.description: The point in time to evaluate cumulative limits against — normally the start of the next FDP. Rolling windows are computed backwards from this timestamp.

fdp_log.title: Fdp Log
fdp_log.description: Ordered list of recent FDPs (chronological). The API computes all rolling windows from this data. Preferred over `summary` — provide at least 365 days of history for full coverage.

summary.description: Pre-aggregated totals for each rolling window. Used as a fallback when a full FDP log is not available. Only fields relevant to your appendix need to be provided.

local_time_offset_hours.title: Local Time Offset Hours
local_time_offset_hours.description: UTC offset of the local time zone at the departure point (hours).

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: Number of sectors (flights) in the FDP.

actual_flight_time_hours.title: Actual Flight Time Hours
actual_flight_time_hours.description: Total flight time within this FDP (hours). When provided, checked against the per-FDP flight time limit for appendices that have one (e.g. Appendices 2, 3, 6).

extension.description: Extension applied to this FDP, if any.

augmented_crew.description: Augmented crew configuration. Only applicable to Appendix 2.

split_duty.description: Split duty rest details, if a split duty rest was taken during this FDP.

consecutive_early_starts.title: Consecutive Early Starts
consecutive_early_starts.description: Number of consecutive early starts (0500–0659 local) preceding this FDP.

consecutive_wocl_infringements.title: Consecutive Wocl Infringements
consecutive_wocl_infringements.description: Number of consecutive WOCL infringements preceding this FDP.

single_pilot.title: Single Pilot
single_pilot.description: Whether this is a single-pilot operation (Appendices 4B, 5).

preceding_off_duty_hours.title: Preceding Off Duty Hours
preceding_off_duty_hours.description: Duration of preceding off-duty period (hours). Required for Appendix 2 unknown acclimatisation table lookup.

reduction_claimed.title: Reduction Claimed
reduction_claimed.description: Set to True if a reduced ODP has been claimed under the applicable reduction provision. When True, the API validates that all eligibility conditions for the reduction are satisfied.

preceding_off_duty.description: Details of the off-duty period before the preceding FDP. Required to evaluate reduction eligibility (Appendices 2, 3, 4).

following_off_duty_location.title: Following Off Duty Location
following_off_duty_location.description: Where the off-duty period is being taken.

following_off_duty_includes_local_night.title: Following Off Duty Includes Local Night
following_off_duty_includes_local_night.description: Whether the off-duty period includes a local night.

acclimatisation_state.title: Acclimatisation State
acclimatisation_state.description: Acclimatisation state (for displacement time calculation under Appendix 2).

roster_start_utc.title: Roster Start Utc
roster_start_utc.description: Start of the roster period (ISO 8601 UTC).

roster_end_utc.title: Roster End Utc
roster_end_utc.description: End of the roster period (ISO 8601 UTC).

events.title: Events
events.description: Ordered roster events (chronological). Each event must have `event_type` set to 'fdp', 'off_duty', or 'rest_day'.

prior_fdp_log.title: Prior Fdp Log
prior_fdp_log.description: FDP history before the roster period, used for cumulative limit checks. Provide at least 365 days of history for full coverage. Preferred over `prior_summary`.

prior_summary.description: Pre-aggregated cumulative totals from before the roster period. Used as a fallback when a full prior FDP log is unavailable.

events.title: Events
events.description: Ordered sequence of FDP and off-duty events (chronological). Each event must have `event_type` set to either 'fdp' or 'off_duty'. The sequence should cover the full roster window being validated.

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: True if no violations were found; False otherwise.

violations.title: Violations
violations.description: All violations found. Empty list if valid.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: All checks evaluated, including those that passed.

calculation_notes.title: Calculation Notes
calculation_notes.description: Clause-referenced calculation breakdown from the limit engine.

ValidationResponse.title: ValidationResponse
ValidationResponse.description:
Validation result showing all checks run and any violations found.

The top-level `valid` flag is False if any violations were detected.
All checks evaluated — including those that passed — are included in
the `checks` list for full auditability.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Severity: 'hard_limit' is a regulatory breach, 'soft_limit' is an exceedance of a soft cap, 'warning' is advisory.

Violation.title: Violation
Violation.description: A compliance violation found during validation.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: API status and discovery. Use the health endpoint to verify the API is running and discover available features.

tags.name: Regulatory Content
tags.description: Access the text of CAO 48.1 sections and appendices. Useful for understanding the rules behind validation results.

tags.name: Calculation
tags.description: Calculate maximum FDP limits and minimum off-duty periods based on operational parameters. Does not validate — just returns the applicable limits.

tags.name: Validation
tags.description: Validate duty periods, off-duty periods, cumulative limits, duty sequences, and full rosters against CAO 48.1 rules. Returns all violations found with clause references.
